name: Cargo workspace manifests, schedule risk indicators, and packages

planSteps.description: Navigate to /cargo on the PolarOps frontend
Verify Cargo Consignments workspace header 'Cargo Consignments - Operational cargo manifests, transit tracking, and schedule risk' is visible
Verify search input, cargo status dropdown, and risk level pills (All Risks, Nominal, Moderate, Elevated, Critical) are present
Click on a consignment code chip or row to open the ConsignmentDetailPanel drawer
Verify drawer displays consignment overview with priority, route, compliance status, and provenance tag
Verify operational timeline displays schedule milestones, buffer hours, and risk assessment
Verify cargo packages sub-table renders packages and provides 'Add Package' button
